text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing and controlling threats to a project or business. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong and how likely it is to happen. Once risks are clear, you can develop mitigation strategies to reduce their impact or prevent them entirely. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup solution ready if a problem actually occurs. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. Regular reviews help you notice new dangers early and adjust your plans. Good risk management does not remove all problems, but it helps you respond calmly and protect your goals.
